lines: Despite some of the mercenaries withdrawing due to injuries, the drone siege had been successfully overcome, and the trucks had safely made it out of Tokyo Kingdom.
After driving for a bit, we slowly came to a stop in a deserted parking lot.
Looks like we've arrived at the destination.
Upon hearing those words the mercenaries all loosened up, and they began congratulating each other, making plans to get drinks, and whatnot.
Sakura covered her mouth for some reason and was trying her best not to laugh.
It's because, that woman, she's putting on an act! She can speak completely normal, but she does that mechanical voice! Pffheh.
While Sakura was trying her best not to laugh, I stared at the research facility that seemed to be our destination.
(If I remember correctly... then this is...)
Don't you find it funny?! It's just a character she made up!!
No, I was just thinking, "I knew it."
By, "I knew it," I was referring to our destination. As well as the uneasiness regarding the job itself that I had constantly felt.
One might think that this research facility, which had been our destination, would be a business rumored to have connections to Nomad...
I didn't know what might be going on behind the scenes, but at the very least I couldn't imagine a company manufacturing baby diapers would be interested in our "cargo."
(Of course there might be a huge underground organization behind the scenes, using this company as a front, but... probably not.)
It's just a hunch, but what if the actual destination of the "cargo" wasn't here...?
Or ratherーtransporting this "cargo" wasn't even the mission in the first place?
Ehh, Fuma-kun, do you mean that...
Really... There's no need to keep up the act at this point! It's just bleugh!!!
Perhaps she was trying to mess with her, but Sakura kept hitting Faust on the shoulder. Just watching her made me nervous.
N-No, we were just talking about how if the mission is over we can finally receive our payment!
Yeah, yeah, our payment!! And also about where we'll go for our luxury dinner.
Your payment, hmm. You're right. I have to pay you...
That's what I just told you!
The other mercenaries also gathered around when they heard mention of the word "payment."
This is what I've been waiting for!
Don't be in such a rush... No need to worry, I will properly pay you.
A wad of cash was... not what was shown in my direction. It was actually the muzzle of a large custom handgun.
Wait a sec!? What do you think you're doing all of a sudden!?
What's the matter, did the kids do something?
By the time we noticed, Faust's subordinates were pointing guns at the mercenaries from behind.
Orders from our client. Apparently they don't want people to know where this "cargo" is going.
The mercenaries were seething with anger at the sudden turn of events, but were unable to move with Faust's subordinates pointing their guns at them.
(So she's not going to allow even a single one of the mercenaries she scrounged up to go home alive... shit!)
I will pay you as promised. It will look as if you got blinded by the money and had a falling out with each other.
I see, it's true that if that happened, no one would be surprised that it was this bunch.
I looked around at the faces of the mercenaries.
Faust's black finger reached for the trigger of her giant handgun.
Sakura tried to jump forward to protect me. But before she couldー
Faust's body was shaken by the impact and she cried out in pain.
I got... shot? Who the hell did that...?
The good-natured Orc mercenary who had complimented Sakura appeared from behind a bush with his gun still aimed at Faust.
I was listening from the shadows over there, and that's a nasty little story, huh?
Hngh... ggh, you dare to ambush me...
I've been a mercenary for years, but this is my first time seeing a situation as awful as this.
But why!? When did you hide!?
I heard everything from him over there. How a lot of things were "strange" and how it might be a good idea not to trust our client.
From Fuma-kun? What do you mean "strange?"
When we were attacked by those drones earlier, I managed to look at the "cargo"...
Inside the cargo had been bare, unarmored machine parts, most likely the core of a drone or something like that.
The fact that the UFS attacked us during transport suggested that those parts had been stolen from the UFS and were probably a military secret that was still under development.
And our destination had been the research facility of a company making baby products, which most likely had nothing to do with secret military research...
That's when I had gotten a bad feeling. So, I had those guys over there break away for a moment.
Is that what you meant when you said you're "withdrawing because you were injured"!?
We were pursuing you on our own after that, but it looks like his hunch was spot on!
Thanks for your help. I was on the verge of getting killed.
Fuma-kun, you planned all of this behind the scenes!? Why didn't you tell me?!
I mean, Sakura, If had I told you, your behavior would've given it away immediately.
Hmph... I can't really deny that...
Tsk... Who knew a kid like you found his way into the mercenaries.
Sorry things didn't go the way you wanted. I'm not such an idiot that I'll be meekly disposed of.
Interesting. Little boy... no, tell me your name.
Fuma, huh. I commend you. But now you die!
And as soon as Faust shouted, a hidden blade flew out of her body.
Whoa!? Just how many weapons does this woman carry!?
Dodged it, hmm. Well whatever, it's all the same if I slaughter you all!
The women who were apparently Faust's subordinates again readied their guns.
This looks like I have to get a bit serious.
Yeah, let's go, without letting our guard down!
